PrincipalKind.description: A person, or an agent holding a bearer on a person's behalf.

levels.description:
Approval levels the principal decides proposals at (product-defined
level keys, as a proposal's chain names them). Absent reads as none:
the viewer decides nothing. Agents hold none.

roles.description:
Product-defined roles, e.g. to pick a default workspace. Absent
reads as none. Display and defaults only: the core enforces access.
